renderer.denoisingRationale: Denoising disabled because transparent capture edges caused repeatable RGB ringing at independently assembled module boundaries. Use 256 native samples for quiet surfaces.
renderer.joinAntialiasing: Exact source join planes align with integer pixels; box reconstruction avoids double-softened independent-alpha gaps

horizontalLightContract.worldDirectionDependency: Z only, no X/Y position ramp
horizontalLightContract.paperEmission: camera ray only, no diffuse/glossy illumination emission

reconstruction: No AI image textures, target billboard, raster fitting, painted seams or per-view adjustments. Geometry is directly editable native Blender mesh.

reproductionEntryPoint.note: Direct native capture from the self-contained immutable scene. Original build scripts describe native geometry reconstruction; scene render requires no original backup, entrance library, texture image or external model.
